summary: The school district emphasizes the importance of preserving E-Rate funding for Pre-K and Head Start programs to maintain educational access and program quality.

claims.requested_action: Preserve E-Rate funding for Pre-K and Head Start programs
claims.argument: Without E-Rate, Pre-K and Head Start programs would face significant budget cuts and staffing reductions
claims.evidence_quote: Without this funding, without E-Rate the only element we could cut from program expenses would be individualized skill building activities for children, this would impede children's readiness for kindergarten.
